ideas.pitch: A decentralized medical history storage system that uses zero-knowledge proofs to let patients share specific health credentials with doctors without revealing their entire medical background.
ideas.title: MediProof ZK Records
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Healthcare and Web3/Blockchain tracks while leveraging hard engineering patterns seen in winning ZK projects like UC Berkeley ZKP Hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: A ZK-gated community platform for HackBIOS participants where human developers and autonomous AI agents can collaboratively review code while keeping implementation secrets hidden.
ideas.title: AgentStoa Junwani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Open Innovation and AI/ML tracks by implementing advanced AI agents and cryptographic privacy mechanics proven at the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A secure multi-party computation collaboration platform built for EdTech assignments, allowing students to submit collaborative code without exposing individual answers to peers.
ideas.title: HermitEd Secure Multi-Party Classroom
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the EdTech track by applying heavy privacy-preserving multi-party computation patterns that previously won the Filecoin data economy hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized authentication and certificate issuance dApp for educational institutions running on Solana to prevent credential fraud during hackathon submissions.
ideas.title: SolAuth Campus Credentials
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Cybersecurity and Web Development tracks using fast, reliable smart contract authentication patterns from Superteam Turkey Solana Hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized privacy-first crypto asset management and automated inheritance wallet utilizing zero-knowledge cryptographic primitives.
ideas.title: WillWallet FinTech Privacy Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speaks directly to the FinTech track by implementing advanced privacy-preserving transaction protocols proven at the ETH Privacy Istanbul Hackathon.
